To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The effect of measurement error on parameter estimates in structural equation modeling is dependent upon the nature of the measurement model.

1) the measurement model is the most important part of a structural equation model, 2) the measurement model must be tested first, 3) the model fit statistics are not very helpful in determining the fit of the measurement model, and 4) the measurement model can be tested with a single factor model, and a two factor model.

(1) the effect of measurement error is to attenuate the magnitude of all parameter estimates, and (2) the magnitude of this attenuation is greater for the direct effects than for the indirect effects, and greater for the indirect effect of X on Y than for the indirect effect from X to Y through a mediating variable.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a comparison of three methods of estimating structural equation models with latent variables.
the effects of measurement error on the parameter estimates obtained from structural models.
the effect of measurement error on the estimation of structural models in the LISREL approach to structural equation modeling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of measurement error on the parameter estimates in structural equation models can be quite substantial.
the effects of measurement error on structural equation modeling parameters can be minimized, but not eliminated, through the utilization of the expanded factor analysis model.
the effects of measurement error on the various parameters are a function of both the reliability of the variables and their interrelations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the effects of measurement error on structural equation modeling can be understood in terms of the effects of measurement on the factor structure of a set of observed variables.
the effect of measurement error on the parameter estimates of the structural equation model can be substantial.
measurement errors in a structural equation model can be estimated by using the structural equation models themselves.
The main takeaway from our work is that
measurement error in the dependent variable is not a major problem in structural equation modeling.
measurement error in structural equation modeling can have a large effect on the results of a study.
the use of structural equation models with measurement errors is a good idea.
